notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2), S3-FIX2/N2 (decision 2026-11-18 #3): a valid zip container also holds readable/a and an entry whose path has a '..' segment; the file entry ../x comes first in the central directory and readable/a after it. The unsafe entry is E_CONTAINER_ENTRY (§11.9), and readable/a passed its own entry checks, so N_READABLE_PRESENT is reported (§11.8) regardless of the entries' order in the central directory. The Rust verifier stopped at the first failing entry and did not report the notice when the unsafe entry came first.
